description: Source code for managing Python Dimname interned strings in PyTorch, including interned string table management, utility functions for checking and parsing Dimnames, and integration with Python C API.
external_files: python C API headers (implied by usage of PyObject*, Py_INCREF, etc.)

classes.name: InternedStringsTable
classes.description: Manages a hash map of interned Python strings to Dimname objects, with methods for lookup and adding mappings, and proper cleanup in destructor.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Looks up a PyObject* in the interned string table, returning an optional Dimname.

methods.name: addMapping
methods.description: Adds a mapping from a PyObject* interned string to a Dimname, increasing reference count to manage lifetime.

methods.name: ~InternedStringsTable
methods.description: Destructor that releases references to interned strings if Python is initialized.

methods.name: THPUtils_checkDimname
methods.description: Checks if a PyObject* is None or a string, indicating a valid Dimname.

methods.name: THPUtils_checkDimnameList
methods.description: Checks if a PyObject* is a list or tuple with a first element that is a valid Dimname.

methods.name: THPDimname_parse
methods.description: Parses a PyObject* into a Dimname, handling interned strings and creating new Dimname objects.
